scope: 12 cubes: 4 variables x 3 windows x 288 months (2001-01..2024-12)

inference.why_seasonal: A monthly series with a strong annual cycle would make the original Mann-Kendall test read the seasonal swing as a trend. The seasonal test (Hirsch & Slack 1984) sums S and Var(S) within each calendar month, so the annual cycle cannot leak into the test statistic.

aggregation.weighting: cos(latitude) area weights on each product's native grid
aggregation.slope_source: the area-weighted regional series, never the mean of per-cell slopes
aggregation.why: Cell slopes have different variances; averaging them would not estimate the regional slope and would break comparability across windows with different cell counts.

seasonal_adjustment.method: subtract the per-season mean computed over the analysed series
seasonal_adjustment.baseline: per-season mean of the analysed period (reported with every result)
seasonal_adjustment.why: Sen slopes are estimated on anomalies so the annual cycle cannot bias the slope; the baseline is always disclosed so the anomaly definition is reproducible.

minimum_series.insufficient_data_behavior: state=insufficient_data with null slope, p-value and interval; never zero, never a guess

dependence.why: Serial dependence inflates the variance of S; without correction the test is anti-conservative. The same correction is used for maps and cards so they cannot disagree.

bootstrap.estimand: Theil-Sen slope in units per year
bootstrap.why_blocks: Independent resampling would destroy the annual cycle and serial dependence; 12-month circular blocks preserve both.
bootstrap.not_used: The intercept of the Sen fit is NOT a confidence interval and is never reported as one.

multiplicity.family: all eligible cells within one variable x window analysis
multiplicity.why: Testing thousands of cells at alpha=0.05 would label roughly 5% of no-trend cells as significant. FDR is controlled at q=0.10 within a stated family, and the family is reported.

period_sensitivity.why_fixed: The window set is frozen in advance so a reversal cannot be manufactured by choosing a window after seeing the answer.
period_sensitivity.sign_agreement_note: The sign-agreement fraction is descriptive and depends on the fixed window set; it is not a calibrated probability.

qa.note: MODIS uses MODLAND QA bits 0-1 with reliability 0-1 in default mode; IMERG quality index is reported, never used to exclude cells.

units.temperature: K in the cube; display C = K - 273.15; slopes are numerically identical in K/yr and C/yr
units.soil_moisture: kg m-2; not a percentage and not relative humidity
units.precipitation: mm/hr monthly mean rate; mm/month = value x hours in month (state the conversion on the card)

interpretation_rules.p_value_wording: A p-value is the probability of data at least as extreme as observed if the no-trend null were true. It is never the probability that a trend exists, nor the probability that a trend is due to chance.
interpretation_rules.inconclusive_state: Show the effect size and the interval, label the result inconclusive, never hide it.
interpretation_rules.no_significance_before_gate: Significance labels may only be produced by this library with this method_revision after the test suite and the external comparison pass.
